description: Defines the OMXBuffer class used for media buffer management in Android's media framework, including buffer types, constructors, and HIDL transition support.

classes.name: OMXBuffer
classes.description: Represents a media buffer with various types (shared memory, native handle, HIDL memory, etc.) used in Android media framework.

methods.name: OMXBuffer()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an invalid buffer.

methods.name: OMXBuffer(const sp<MediaCodecBuffer> &codecBuffer)
methods.description: Constructs a preset buffer from a MediaCodecBuffer.

methods.name: OMXBuffer(OMX_U32 rangeOffset, OMX_U32 rangeLength)
methods.description: Constructs a preset buffer with specified range.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the buffer to a parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes the buffer from a parcel.
